figmaCorrections.issue: The 'Text/Hint' variable resolves to #374151 in the variable table, but the handoff renders all hint/placeholder/column-head/secondary text as #6b7280. The token value and its rendered usage disagree.
figmaCorrections.recommendation: Reconcile the Text/Hint token to the intended rendered value (#6b7280) or rename the variable so the value matches its usage, to avoid token drift in implementation.

figmaCorrections.issue: The 'Type' column status value 'Mapped' is plain Body-1 text (#374151, 16/400) with no chip/badge. Status values usually read better as a styled pill for scannability; plain text is easy to confuse with adjacent data columns.
figmaCorrections.recommendation: Consider a low-emphasis status chip (subtle fill + label) for the Type column so mapped/unmapped state is visually distinct from plain data cells.

figmaCorrections.issue: The 'Unmap' control is a #003366 text button with a link_off icon. Unmap is a destructive/reversing action, but the design gives it the same primary-blue color as non-destructive links, providing no visual cue of consequence.
figmaCorrections.recommendation: Consider a distinct treatment (e.g. neutral/secondary or a confirmed danger style) for destructive row actions so users can distinguish reversible-mapping actions from plain navigation links.
